info.title: API.SH: Macy's
info.description: The Macy's API from API.SH: public Macy's data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Macy's search-box suggestions for the start of a query.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/macys-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Start of a search.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of suggestions (up to 20, default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of a Macy's (US) category page: name, brand, regular and sale price, percent off, promotions, rating and review count, colors, availability and images, about 60 per page, plus the category (name, link, parent, top level, breadcrumbs, description), the filter facets with counts, the sort options and related categories. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Filter with `filter=Facet:value` values copied from `facets[].values[].filter`; repeat `filter` for several facets or several values of one facet.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/macys-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A macys.com/shop/... category link with its `?id=`, or pass `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric category id (the `id=` in the category link) instead of url.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet value as `Facet:value`, copied from `facets[].values[].filter` (for example `Brand:Calvin Klein`, `Color_normal:Black`). Repeat the parameter for more filters (up to 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A macys.com product URL.

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Macy's product: rating, title, text, author nickname and location, date, recommended, helpful votes, fit/size sub-ratings and photos, 30 per page by default (up to 100). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/macys-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric product id, or pass `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A macys.com product URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page (1-100, default 30).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products for a keyword search on Macy's (US): name, brand, regular and sale price, percent off, promotions, rating and review count, colors, availability and images, about 60 per page, plus the filter facets with counts and the sort options. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Filter with `filter=Facet:value` values copied from `facets[].values[].filter`; repeat `filter` for several facets or several values of one facet.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/macys-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet value as `Facet:value`, copied from `facets[].values[].filter` (for example `Gender:Men`, `Brand:Levi's`, `Price:0|19.99`). Repeat the parameter for more filters (up to 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
